proposals.evidence: DEDR 3633 full article (p. 321) gives 3633 Ta. nā, nākku, nāvu tongue; nāvu (nāvi-) to thrust out the tongue and move it sideways, mock by thrusting out the tongue. Ma. nā, nākku, nāvu tongue. Ko. na·lg id.; na·v tongue, esp. of Bhat nālkɨ “tongue” matches Lindgren Koraga nālkɨ “tongue” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
